title: AI-Augmented Attack Path and Lateral Analysis Foundation
goal: Add confidence-scored inferred attack-path context without activating lateral movement or exploitation.
scope: Extend the deterministic attack-path layer with optional, clearly marked inferred edges and lateral-analysis notes derived from existing inventory, findings, identity/cloud observations, and evidence. Inferred edges must carry confidence and source rationale, stay visually distinct from confirmed edges, and never trigger active pivoting or scope expansion.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md calls for lateral movement reasoning and AI-augmented edge inference beyond the existing deterministic attack-path graph.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Inferred analysis only. Do not add active pivoting, credential reuse testing, cloud exploitation, lateral movement execution, or scope expansion.

success_criteria: Attack-path responses can include confirmed and inferred edges with clear distinction.
Inferred edges include confidence, rationale, and evidence/inventory references.
UI distinguishes inferred analysis from confirmed path data.
No active lateral movement, credential testing, or pivot execution is introduced.
Tests cover inferred, confirmed-only, sparse-data, and no-scope-expansion cases.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Inferred edges are clearly marked and confidence-scored.
No active lateral movement or scope expansion is introduced.

before_promotion: LLM-driven intake intelligence foundation is completed and logged.
Inferred-edge semantics and visual distinction are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with AI-augmented attack-path changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with inferred-path boundaries and remaining lateral limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Automatic task dispatch from inferred edges
